posts.t: Hurricanes announce they've activated Seth Jarvis (off-season shoulder surgery) from injured non-roster list.
Seth Jarvis has been activated from IR, and Bradly Nadeau has been reassigned to AHL Chicago.
Brind'Amour says Jarvis "is getting closer." No commitment to him playing tomorrow in Edmonton, but what Brind'Amour shows in practice is usually what he shows in games.
Looks like Jarvis might be a go in Edmonton
